errors.evidence: The description inaccurately states that the light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) increases steadily to around 2% by Layer 29-32; it actually has an increasing trend but ends close to 0%.
The description states the yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts at approximately -1% and reaches about 4%, when it actually starts slightly higher than -1% and ends around 3%.
The description indicates that the red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) ends at around 5% for Layer 29-32, while it actually reaches only approximately 0%.
The description does not mention that the dashed gray line represents the baseline for '4×tokens, 4-bit' at 0%, nor does it clarify that it remains constant across all layers.
